news.title: Busy Station Day with Bioprinting, Spacesuit Check, Robotics, and Photography
news.summary: The Expedition 75 crew had a busy day on Thursday bioprinting blood vessels and trying on a spacesuit aboard the International Space Station. The orbital residents also trained to use a pair of robotic arms and set up Earth photography sessions to round out the day in low Earth orbit.

news.title: NASA’s Hubble Charts Path for Roman with Gravitational Lenses
news.summary: This observation is one of many gravitational lensing images taken by Hubble in preparation for science with the new Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.

news.summary: NASA tested RS-25 engine No. 10001 on Oct. 21 on the Fred Haise Test Stand at NASA’s Stennis Space Center near Bay St. Louis, Mississippi. news.title: Spacesuits, Lunar Agriculture, and Breathing Research Top Wednesday’s Schedule
news.summary: Spacesuit checks topped Wednesday’s task list aboard the International Space Station as two astronauts prepare for a spacewalk next week. The Expedition 75 crew members also kept up advanced microgravity research exploring space agriculture and the respiratory system midweek.

news.title: Blood Vessel Printing, Cancer Research, and Spacewalk Preps Keep Crew Busy
news.summary: Expedition 75 spent Tuesday advancing human health on and off the Earth with 3D bioprinting, cancer research, and exercise studies. Meanwhile, spacewalk preparations continue aboard the International Space Station to augment its power generation system.

news.title: Two NASA Commercial Satellite Communication Demonstrations Launch
news.summary: Two NASA-funded demonstrations have successfully launched into low Earth orbit aboard the SpaceX Bandwagon-5 rideshare. news.title: Spacewalk Preps and Advanced Biomedical Research Begin Week
news.summary: Spacewalk preparations kicked off the week aboard the International Space Station as two astronauts get ready to install a roll-out solar array at the end of October. Biomedical research, including portable biological sampling in microgravity and 3D cell printing, topped the science schedule for the Expedition 75 crew.

news.title: Crew Unpacks Dragon and Begins Activating New Science Experiments
news.summary: Five spacecraft are docked at the International Space Station following the arrival of a cargo-packed SpaceX Dragon on Thursday. The Expedition 75 crew members have begun unloading Dragon and are activating new science experiments to benefit life on and off the Earth.

news.summary: Observing across the starry “plains” of space, the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope has taken images of NGC 2392, nicknamed the Lion Nebula.

news.title: Photo Release: Webb pinpoints millions of stars within Cigar Galaxy
news.summary: Located 12 million light-years away and undergoing rapid star formation, edge-on spiral galaxy Messier 82 (M82) is a scientifically unique sight to behold, and now the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope has revealed previously unseen details.

news.title: Science Release: Webb finds clues to ancient, distant origin of Comet 3I/ATLAS
news.summary: The third identified interstellar comet in human history has a surprising chemical makeup, raising questions as to how common, or unusual, conditions in our own Solar System may be.
